🎙️ Message from the MD

Welcome to the Aditi Tracking Knowledge Base Portal

Dear Aditi Tracking Team,Think of global brands like McDonald's 🍔 — known for delivering consistent quality, service, and experience worldwide. This level of excellence comes from clear systems, defined processes, and empowered people.

At Aditi Tracking, we are building the same standard.This portal is created for you — your personal platform to learn, grow, and succeed independently 🚀. Here, you can access SOPs, checklists, KPIs, role clarity, and growth paths — all in one place.

We believe in transparency 🤝, continuous learning 📘, and equal opportunities for everyone to grow.Today, we are proud to be among India’s leading telematics companies 🇮🇳. Tomorrow, we aim to become the world’s number one 🌍 — and that journey begins with you.

Let’s build excellence together.

Chirag Rachh Founder & Managing Director

Aditi Tracking Support Pvt Ltd

Founded Aditi Tracking Support Pvt. Ltd. (ATSPL) · 2011 · Mumbai, India

❓ FAQs 23 Questions
Frequently asked questions about Aditi Tracking’s products, services, and features. Click on any question to view the answer.
1 What is a Fleet Management System?
The Fleet Management System is an avant-garde, intelligent combination of features that are engineered to protect your assets from theft and misplacement. You can manage fleet operations with real-time vehicle status and ensure safety with instant speeding & violation alarms.
2 How does the Fleet Management System actually work?
It safeguards your vehicle and improves customer experience by purveying high-tech state-of-the-art solutions like Vehicle Tracking, Fuel Monitoring, Asset Management, Temperature Management, E.V Solutions, and more. This intuitive fleet management software is tried, tested, and effective, and can be integrated into your vehicle conveniently.
3 What are the benefits of using a Fleet Management System?
Fleet Management Software is packed with several distinctive benefits. Through this cutting-edge, utility-driving system, you are offered Intelligent GPS Tracking with live alerts, PAN India Service, and SOS/Panic Button. The comprehensive Fleet Management System also includes a web dashboard and native mobile application access, live real-time tracking of your vehicle, and top-notch service with hassle-free installation.
4 How does the RTO Approved AIS 140 Vehicle Tracking System work?
The RTO Approved AIS 140 Vehicle Tracking System renders the real-time location of your car and provides easy access to 24/7 vehicle tracking. The system also incorporates futuristic features like an emergency response button and the Intelligent Driver Scoring methodology.
5 How do I reduce fuel consumption in vehicles with a Fleet Management System?
With the Fleet Management System, fuel monitoring becomes seamlessly possible. The reliable GPS Integrated Fuel Monitoring System enables you to track and reconcile your fuel inventory from a central dashboard. Thus, you can view a consolidated report of fuel usage, wastage and drip duration within a single click. The fleet management system also provides fuel consumption tracking that not only prompts you in case of fuel theft but also shows you the exact location and time of when the theft occurred. With the comprehensive fuel mileage and idle wastage analysis, you can save fuel significantly by cutting down on wastage and optimizing your travels.
6 Which is the best mobile-friendly Fleet Management System?
Aditi Tracking's Fleet Management Software is one of the most cutting-edge tech-first systems for vehicle and asset protection that also works seamlessly on your smartphone. Through intuitive applications, you can access crucial information about your vehicle and monitor the same at all times. The SIM-tracking solution is compatible with all major network providers and is efficient & cost-effective.
7 What is GPS fleet tracking software, and how does it work?
GPS fleet tracking software lets you monitor trucks, cars, and commercial vehicles in real-time using satellite data. Aditi Tracking's GPS solution shows live location, route history, vehicle health, and driver behavior to improve safety, efficiency, and operational control.
8 How does a GPS tracker operate?
A GPS tracker communicates with satellites to determine location. This data is sent to Aditi Tracking's platform via mobile networks, where users can monitor vehicle activity, set geofences, and get AI-powered alerts on events like speeding or unauthorized movement.
9 What is an OBD GPS tracker?
An OBD (On-Board Diagnostics) GPS tracker plugs into your vehicle's OBD-II port, commonly found in cars and light commercial vehicles. It not only tracks location but also sends engine diagnostics and performance data.
10 How do I install a real-time GPS tracker in my truck or car?
It depends on the device type. Plug-and-play devices can be self-installed in the OBD-II port within minutes. Professional installation is available through Aditi Tracking for hardwired options in trucks and heavy commercial vehicles.
11 Is it easy to install and set up Aditi Tracking devices?
Yes! Our plug-and-play GPS units are ready to go instantly. For larger fleets or commercial vehicles, we offer full installation support by trained technicians.
12 What warranty do you offer on your GPS tracking hardware?
All Aditi Tracking devices come with a standard warranty. For exact terms, check the product manual or reach out to our support team.
13 Will GPS tracking work in areas with poor or no mobile network?
Yes. While data transmission uses cellular networks, our devices store data during outages and sync it once coverage is restored, ensuring you don't lose trip data.
14 How does GPS tracking help individuals and businesses in India?
For both personal and business use, GPS tracking improves security, route planning, and fuel efficiency. It also helps transporters comply with local vehicle movement laws like AIS-140.
15 How can Aditi Tracking improve driver safety and asset utilization?
Our AI-driven platform monitors driver behavior, flagging speeding, harsh braking, and idling. This helps with driver training and ensures trucks and vehicles are used optimally.
16 What are the benefits of using a telematics solution for fleet managers?
Telematics solutions like Aditi Tracking offer live tracking, driver scorecards, vehicle health monitoring, and fuel insights, leading to lower operational costs and better decision-making.
17 Is it cost-effective? How much does it save?
Absolutely. With GPS tracking, companies reduce fuel expenses, cut idle time, prevent misuse, and lower maintenance costs, often seeing ROI within months.
18 What's the price of Aditi Tracking GPS units in India?
Prices range from ₹3,500 to ₹15,500 based on features (basic tracking to full telematics). Check our website for the latest pricing or get a custom quote based on your fleet size.
19 Can I get a demo before purchase?
Yes! We offer free product demos so you can see how the system works with your fleet setup. Just reach out to our team.
20 Is Aditi Tracking AIS-140 certified?
Yes. Our devices are compliant with AIS-140, a mandatory government standard for GPS devices in commercial and public transport vehicles in India.
21 How does GPS tracking protect against vehicle theft?
Our solution includes real-time location monitoring, geofence alerts, and even remote engine immobilization, enabling fast response during theft attempts.
22 Can your system integrate with our current software or ERP?
Yes, we offer easy API integrations with existing ERP, logistics, and transport management systems for seamless data flow.
23 Do you offer 24/7 customer support?
Yes! Our dedicated support team is available round-the-clock to help with setup, troubleshooting, or any queries you might have.
Still have questions? Visit adititracking.com/faqs or contact our team.

🏢Our Story

Aditi Tracking Support Pvt. Ltd. (ATSPL) was founded in 2011 by Chirag Rachh, who after losing his job at a telecom company decided to embark on an entrepreneurial journey. Driven by a passion for telematics and GPS technology, he founded Aditi Tracking with a single-minded focus on success.

Since 2011, Aditi Tracking has established itself as a trusted name among the top GPS tracking companies in India, specialising in advanced GPS tracking solutions that help businesses monitor commercial fleets, reduce operational costs, and enhance safety.

🏆Company Milestones — 15-Years Journey
2011
Birth of the Leader
Chirag Rachh founded Aditi Tracking Support Pvt. Ltd. (ATSPL) in Mumbai after a decade in telecom. GPS tracking for commercial fleets was the core focus.
2012
Geographic Expansion
Started operations in Pune, Nagpur & Indore — taking Aditi's telematics solutions beyond Mumbai.
2014
Government Partnerships
Aditi partners with Government Projects, marking a major step towards large-scale fleet compliance solutions.
2016
Fuel Monitoring Pioneer
First to introduce Fuel Monitoring Solution — a breakthrough in reducing fuel theft and operational costs for fleets.
2017
Global Recognition
Franchise operations launched. Participated in Global EXPO events — Dubai, ZYTEX, HKTDC — establishing international presence.
2018
Public Sector Vehicle Fleet
Opportunity to work with 20+ PSVs (Public Service Vehicles) — expanding government & institutional client base.
2019
Quality Certifications
Acquired ISO Certification & CMMI Level 3 certification — validating process excellence and quality commitment.
2020
AIS 140 Compliance
Aditi Tracking gets AIS 140 Certified — government-mandated GPS standard for commercial vehicles in India.
2021
Goa Operations Launch
Expanded to Goa, serving North & South Goa's growing commercial fleet market.
2022
Ahmedabad Office
Launched Gujarat operations from Ahmedabad — strengthening West India presence.
2023
Cool Bus Solution Launch
Launched Cool Bus — an advanced school bus tracking and student safety solution, entering the education sector.
2024
CommutePulse & WasteTrail
Launched CommutePulse for employee transport tracking and WasteTrail for waste management fleet solutions.
2026
Aditi Tracking Portal
Internal Knowledge based portal launched — unified command centre to track, train and grow.

🖼️Logo Usage Guidelines
✅ Correct Usage
✓ Use on white or light grey backgrounds
✓ Maintain minimum clear space equal to the logo height on all sides
✓ Use the full colour logo (gold + dark text) for primary use
✓ Use white version on dark or coloured backgrounds
✓ Download from company brand assets folder (contact IT)
❌ Do NOT do this
✗ Do not stretch, skew or distort the logo
✗ Do not change the logo colours or add effects
✗ Do not place logo on busy or clashing backgrounds
✗ Do not use outdated or unofficial logo versions
✗ Do not use below 40px height (legibility minimum)
